plain: To lower the worth, quality, or dignity of something.

webster.text: To reduce from a higher to a lower state or rank, in estimation.

example.quote: If the case should only be, that he MIGHT lay it down, unless continued by a new choice, and if he should be desirous of being continued, his wishes, conspiring with his fears, would tend still more powerfully to corrupt his integrity, or debase his fortitude.
